regime_context: Hong Kong theme leadership is concentrated in Banks (H + HK) and Energy (H-shares), the only high-durability eligible themes; rotation breadth is narrowing (only 5 of 17 eligible, 29% fraction). The momentum ranking is a focus lens, not alpha, and the only validated edge is the absolute-trend gate, which is currently keeping low-durability, mean-reverting tech themes out of eligibility.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) closes the 0.184 score margin over Banks (H + HK) AND both themes stay eligible with Energy's durability_bar above 0.8 — a sustained 3-day stretch with Energy ranked #1 and breadth still above 0.8 would signal a confirmed leadership handoff worth acting on.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks lead the ranks and are eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with moderate 0.63 durability and 0.615 breadth. The trend discipline (the only validated leg) supports staying exposed to this leadership theme; crowding_z 0.81 is not crowded, so no sizing-down caution is triggered. However, momentum rank itself has ~0 rank-IC, so this is a stay-the-course lean on a theme already leading, not a return forecast.
evidence: rank 1 with score 1.337, eligible=true under trend gate
r10 -0.0088: short-term momentum is flat, so leadership is durability-driven, not accelerating
theses.dissent: Banks are the incumbent leader and the momentum rank is not predictive; r10 is essentially negative, suggesting the theme's forward momentum may already be exhausted, leaving only the trend gate's downside control as the case for holding exposure.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) drops below its durability_bar of 0.63 and loses eligible status under the trend gate before the check-by date

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Energy is the challenger to Banks with score 1.153, eligible, and is the strongest trend-quality theme in the ranks: durability_bar 0.8, hurst_tag 'trend', breadth 0.9 — the only high-durability, high-breadth, pure-trend theme. The validated trend gate favors exposure here, and the rotation margin over Banks is thin (0.184), but there is no confirmed handoff, so we hold rather than upgrade.
theses.dissent: Energy's rank of 2 has no forward edge (rank-IC ~0) and the margin over Banks is narrow; a mean-reversion in energy commodities or H-share flow could quickly reverse the durability picture without the trend gate catching the turn in time.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) hurst_tag shifts from 'trend' to 'mean-revert' or its durability_bar falls below 0.5 before the check-by date

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is ineligible under the trend gate, has the lowest durability in its cohort (0.22), and hurst_tag 'mean-revert' — the opposite of trend. The one validated edge is drawdown avoidance via the trend gate, and this theme is explicitly outside it. Note this is one of only two scorable themes, but avoiding it is not a short; it is simply not deserving of trend-following exposure.
theses.dissent: A sharp beta rally or Beijing policy catalyst could lift all of HK tech regardless of trend health; the trend gate is a risk-control, not a return predictor, and mean-reverting themes can bounce hard without warning.

falsifier.text: China Tech & Internet regains eligible status under the trend gate (durability_bar recovers above 0.5 and hurst_tag flips to 'trend') before the check-by date
